title: Fondamantal — Admin Dashboard
label: Internal Tooling / Content Management
summary: A purpose-built internal control center for managing content and publishing workflows without touching code.
overview: The Admin Dashboard is the internal control center for the Fondamantal platform—tailored to platform structure and real workflows. It enables independent content management without developer intervention or generic CMS complexity.
problem: Manual updates and generic CMS tools create inefficiency, workflow mismatch, and higher risk of errors during publishing. Off-the-shelf solutions rarely align with platform-specific needs.
approach: Mapped real publishing workflows to identify core functionality requirements
Designed purpose-built controls aligned with specific platform needs
Created clear publishing paths to reduce mistakes and friction
Built a clean, distraction-free interface for focused operation
Established foundation for future access controls and analytics
keyFeatures: Purpose-built controls aligned with platform content structure
Clear publishing workflow reducing errors and friction
Foundation for controlled access and role management
Scalable architecture for analytics and scheduling
Unified management across all platform subsystems
technicalNotes: React / Next.js with component-based admin UI
Structured layout system for consistent admin experience
Form validation and error handling for data integrity
Responsive design for tablet and desktop admin access
outcomes: Reduced operational overhead through streamlined workflows
Improved independence—content managed without developer intervention
Lower error rate through purpose-built publishing controls
Foundation established for future admin feature expansion
[Optional metric: publishing time or error reduction]
